name: Bidirected-Graph Component Construction
definition: For a finite simple graph $H$, replace every edge by its two opposite arcs and apply the union-closed directed-graph construction.
properties: Its coefficient-space components are indexed by the acyclic orientations of $H$, and every component is Euclidean of full coefficient dimension. For $H=K_m$ there are exactly $m!$ components, so component counts are unbounded among union-closed realizable finite convex-treelike classes of VC dimension four.
